arms: affix (shared prefix+suffix declared once in the header; cell carries only the varying middle)
note: Affix factoring declares a column's shared prefix/suffix once and carries only the varying middle per row. Big lossless token win (affix written once not N times) and beats whole-value interning (bpp) because the values are DISTINCT. It was classed as reconstruction/reference indirection in ENCODE-AUTO-DESIGN.md and gated frontier-only BY ANALOGY to keyed-map/dictionary, never directly measured. This harness measures it on a high-cardinality email column with a both-sided affix; the varying middle is a deterministic token NOT derivable from the id, so the model must fetch the middle and reassemble. Returning the bare middle (no reconstruction) or the wrong middle is a FAIL.
finding: FRONTIER-ONLY / DEGRADES. Affix factoring degrades the reconstructed field on 4 of 5 models. Pooled affix-field (email) accuracy across 10 runs: affix 43.3% vs flat 90.0% vs json 90.0% (-46.7pp on the factored field vs flat). Per-model affix-vs-flat delta on email: command-r -1, mistral-nemo -1 to -2, llama-3.1-8b -3 (TOTAL COLLAPSE, 0/3 both sizes), gemma-3-12b 0 to -1 (only model that nearly holds), llama-3.3-70b -1. The decisive failure mode is affix-exclusive: the model applies the affix correctly (wraps prefix+suffix) but substitutes the id or row-number for the real middle, yielding a well-formed, confidently-WRONG value (e.g. expected acct-xnm59@team.example.com, got acct-u0200@team.example.com). This is reconstruction indirection: reassembling a value from a distant header rule is a lookup weak models fail, same family as keyed-map / dictionary / enum. Token win is real (-37% vs flat, -76% vs json) but paid for with silent corruption on most models. NOT safe-tier: gated frontier-only / AllowLossyGrammar, never auto-selected. Confirms the prior by-analogy classification with direct measurement.
measurement_hygiene: Two failure modes were separated. (1) Prefix-drop (model returns middle+suffix, drops 'acct-'): this appears in FLAT too for mistral-nemo, i.e. some models treat 'acct-' as a droppable label even when read verbatim, which depresses that model's ABSOLUTE flat baseline. The honest metric is therefore the affix-vs-flat DELTA, which controls for it. (2) Wrong-middle reconstruction is affix-only and unambiguous, and is the signal the verdict rests on. The json count/row noise (llama-8b count=40 on a 200-row array) is the known weak-model long-array counting failure, unrelated.
